executive_summary: Current ad performance for Mitsubishi shows a healthy average CTR of 3.87%, indicating strong creative resonance, but is currently hampered by high CPMs (₱363.62) and rising acquisition costs compared to historical benchmarks. Total spend for the analyzed period reached ₱2,742.04, generating 30 messages at an average cost of ₱91.40 per message. While the 'JULY ADS 2026' campaign shows the highest engagement, the 'Leads | Multi Models' campaign is proving more cost-effective for direct inquiries.

best_campaigns.name: JULY ADS 2026
best_campaigns.reason: Highest CTR (5.23%) and largest volume of messages (16 total), peaking at ₱45.71 per message on July 3rd.

best_campaigns.name: 📁 2026 | Leads | Multi Models | JULY
best_campaigns.reason: Achieved the lowest recent cost per message at ₱41.28 on July 20th and maintains a strong 4.68% CTR.

worst_campaigns.name: 📁 2026 | Sales | Multi Models | July
worst_campaigns.reason: Highest cost per message (₱141.21) and low conversion efficiency despite decent CTR.

worst_campaigns.name: JUNE ADS - Leads
worst_campaigns.reason: Significant wasted spend with a high cost per message of ₱167.41, showing a decline in lead quality/intent.

winning_ads.insight: The ₱15K/Month hook is significantly outperforming general brand ads.
Strongest daily efficiency for the month of July.

creative_insights: Mirage G4 creative focusing on monthly payments (₱15K+) is the top performer, suggesting price-sensitive targeting is effective.
L300 Business Promos are generating high engagement but have a higher cost per lead than passenger vehicles in current sets.
Xpander 'Low DP' hooks are maintaining average CTR but require creative refreshes to lower the rising CPC.
Video assets (Client Release Video) are paused; historical data shows video often has higher page engagement but requires better CTA placement for sales conversion.
historical_insights: CPM Inflation: CPMs have increased by nearly 200% from 2023 (avg ₱80-₱120) to 2026 (₱363).
Conversion Decline: 2024 'L300 Sales' campaigns achieved ₱17.13 per message, while current costs are 5x higher (₱92+).
Efficiency Loss: The current 'Outcome_Leads' objective is less efficient than the 2023 'Outcome_Engagement' setups which generated significantly more message volume at lower costs.
recommendations: Shift budget from the 'Sales | Multi Models' campaign to the 'Leads | Multi Models' campaign to capitalize on the ₱41.28 cost per message efficiency.
Scale the Mirage G4 '₱15K+/Month' ad immediately as it holds the highest CTR (5.68%) and lowest CPA.
Implement a 'Broad' targeting test or Advantage+ Audience to combat the high ₱363 CPM, as current interest-based targeting may be too saturated.
Re-activate/Refresh the L300 Business Promo with a 'Zero Downpayment' or 'Pay After 90 Days' hook, which historically performed better in 2024.
Consolidate 'July Ads 2026' and 'Multi Models' campaigns into a single CBO (Campaign Budget Optimization) structure to reduce auction overlap and CPA.
